queries: WITH source_stats AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS spatial_count, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), cross_source AS (SELECT AVG(spatial_count) AS avg_count FROM source_stats) SELECT AVG(ss.avg_ratio) AS avg_kept_ratio, COALESCE(SUM(ss.spatial_count), 0) AS total_spatial_count, AVG(ss.spatial_count - cs.avg_count) AS avg_count_excess FROM source_stats AS ss CROSS JOIN cross_source AS cs WHERE ss.spatial_count > cs.avg_count;
